Matargashti is streaming on Netflix, bringing a new series featuring Rajesh Kumar, Adrija Sinha, and Saumya Uniyal to OTT audiences. Created by Siddhant Chavan, the series explores family relationships, personal freedom, and the conflicts that arise when a young woman’s choices challenge her father’s traditional expectations.
 For viewers looking for This Week OTT Releases , Matargashti is another title to discover on Netflix. The streaming platform has listed five episodes of the series, with a storyline centred on Dhara and her complicated relationship with her father.
 Advertisements The series features an ensemble cast including Rajesh Kumar, Adrija Sinha, Saumya Uniyal, Shakti Kumar, Tulika Bannerjee, Sachin Jeet Singh, Aarav Mavi, and Avinash Agarwal.

 Netflix describes Matargashti as a Hindi-language comedy-drama exploring generational differences, family expectations and a young woman’s journey towards independence. The series combines coming-of-age themes with humour and emotional family conflicts.
 According to Netflix’s official listing, the show stars Rajesh Kumar, Adrija Sinha and Saumya Uniyal, supported by Shakti Kumar, Tulika Bannerjee, Sachin Jeet Singh, Aarav Mavi and Avinash Agarwal.

 Matargashti Story: Dhara’s Personal Choices Create Family Conflict 
 The story centres on Dhara, a young woman whose desire to explore her sexuality creates serious disagreements with her father.
 Uncomfortable with his daughter’s decisions, Dhara’s father becomes determined to interfere in her romantic life. His attempts to control her relationships lead to uncomfortable situations, emotional confrontations and moments of comedy.
 At its heart, Matargashti examines the differences between traditional family expectations and the choices of a younger generation.
 The series uses humour to explore sensitive questions about relationships, independence and parental interference.
 Matargashti Cast and Crew 
 Rajesh Kumar, Adrija Sinha and Saumya Uniyal headline the series, with Shakti Kumar, Tulika Bannerjee, Sachin Jeet Singh, Aarav Mavi and Avinash Agarwal appearing in the supporting ensemble.
 Siddhant Chavan is credited as the creator in the supplied production information. Additional writing, direction and production credits have not been independently confirmed.
 Matargashti Episode Notes – Five Episodes Listed on Netflix 
 Netflix has listed five episodes of Matargashti, The series follows Dhara’s experiences and her father’s increasingly determined efforts to interfere with her romantic relationships. Family disagreements, generational differences and unexpected situations form the central themes.
 Individual episode titles, runtimes and episode-by-episode story descriptions have not been verified, so these details should not be published as confirmed information.

 Next Week OTT Releases – Expected on Netflix From 30 October 
 Two more Indian films are being discussed as potential Netflix additions for October 30, 2026. However, their digital premiere dates remain unconfirmed.
 Avaraachan & Sons – Expected Netflix Release 
 The Malayalam film Avaraachan & Sons, directed by Thamby and produced by Listin Stephen under Magic Frames, features Biju Menon in the titular role.
 The cast also includes Sreenath Bhasi, Ganapathi, Grace Antony, Vinay Forrt and Johny Antony.
 The film explores family relationships and the experiences of its central characters. October 30, 2026, is being considered a possible Netflix streaming date, but an official confirmation is awaited.
 Don’t Trouble the Trouble – Expected Netflix Release 
 Fahadh Faasil’s fantasy entertainer Don’t Trouble the Trouble, directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti , is another film being discussed for a possible October 30 OTT premiere.
 Presented by S.S. Rajamouli, the film features child actor Sara in an important role and combines fantasy, comedy and family-oriented storytelling.
 Produced by Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni and S.S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business, the film received a theatrical release in October 2026.
 Although Netflix has been reported as its digital streaming partner, the October 30 premiere date has not been officially confirmed.
